plugins.name: connect
plugins.description: Build and run integrations on the fastn platform from Claude - create connectors, plan syncs, author workflows, build embedded widgets, and run governed, multi-tenant automations across every app your customers connect. The same integrations serve both your product's features and the AI agents it runs for customers, with governed, audited access. Connects Claude to fastn through one governed MCP gateway that dynamically serves fastn's full, growing library of skills, with no manual MCP setup.
